name: GOV.BR
body: Full share cards, language alternates, alt text on every image, and every internal link opened answered. But the home page's Organization and WebSite JSON-LD give a URL with no name, so AI answers get an unnamed entity.
lesson: Add name, and sameAs links to official profiles, to the Organization block. AI answers use it to name the site.
summary: www.gov.br scores 77 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 4 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /pt-br/servicos, /pt-br/servicos/listar_orgaos. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 40 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /pt-br Organization lacks name, /pt-br WebSite lacks name, /pt-br/servicos Organization lacks name and 37 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 18 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /pt-br/servicos, /pt-br/servicos/buscar-servicos-por, /pt-br/categorias, /pt-br/servicos/listar_orgaos and 14 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 22 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 2 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: /pt-br/servicos/listar_orgaos → /pt-br/servicos, /clientes/portalgovbr/portalgovbr/pt-br/servicos/servicos-por-publico-alvo → /pt-br/servicos/servicos-por-publico-alvo. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
Every image has an alt attribute
Language alternates point at each other
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
